# Surface attribution in reporting.py

## Goal

Surface the actor/source/reason attribution in the generated reports and mode-timeline sections.

## Scope

- Update `reporting.py` to surface `source`, `actor`, and `reason` fields from restart events in:
  - The mode-timeline section of the report
  - Any restart attribution tables/sections
- When attribution is present, display: source (colour-coded by type), actor, and reason.
- When attribution is absent, fall back to the existing heuristic classification.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Report sections that mention restarts/mode-switches now show source, actor, and reason when available.
- [ ] Unattributed restarts (marker absent) are still shown with heuristic classification.
- [ ] Source values are displayed consistently: `scheduler`, `worker`, `api`, `manual`.
- [ ] Unit tests cover report output with and without attribution markers.
- [ ] No regression in existing report output.

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/reporting.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** — attribution markers must be parsed in log_parser.py first
data.title: Surface attribution in reporting.py

# Use source attribution in analyze_mode_flips.py

## Goal

Replace the heuristic classification of mode-flip triggers in `analyze_mode_flips.py` with deterministic attribution from the `source` field when available.

## Scope

- Update `classify_trigger()` to use the `source` field from restart events when present.
- Map `source=worker` to `to-cheap` (the ContextHub worker's behaviour).
- Map `source=scheduler` to `schedule`.
- Map `source=api` and `source=manual` to their respective categories.
- Fall back to the existing heuristic classification when `source` is absent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `classify_trigger()` uses `source` field when present, matching expected categories.
- [ ] Fallback to heuristic when attribution is absent (backward compatible).
- [ ] Unit tests cover: all source values present, source absent (heuristic fallback).
- [ ] No regression in existing analyze_mode_flips.py tests.

## Key Files

- `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py`
- `tests/test_mode_flip_analysis.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** — attribution markers must be parsed in log_parser.py first

# Unit tests: attribution marker parsing and report output

## Goal

Comprehensive unit tests covering all attribution marker scenarios.

## Scope

- Tests for `log_parser.py`:
  - Parsing attribution markers present on `Mode-switch restart spawned` lines
  - Parsing attribution markers present on `restart_services: router-mode restart complete` lines
  - Parsing attribution markers present on mode-switch lines
  - Parsing lines without markers (degrades gracefully)
  - Edge cases: missing source/actor/reason fields individually
- Tests for `reporting.py`:
  - Report output with full attribution
  - Report output without attribution (heuristic fallback)
- Tests for `analyze_mode_flips.py`:
  - Classification with source present
  - Classification with source absent (heuristic)
  - Edge cases: unknown source values

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All new marker parsing paths are covered by unit tests.
- [ ] Backward compatibility tests (historical logs without markers) pass.
- [ ] Report output assertions verify source/actor/reason appear in markdown.
- [ ] `analyze_mode_flips.py` classification tests cover all source values.
- [ ] All existing tests still pass (no regression).

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`
- `tests/test_mode_flip_analysis.py`

## Dependencies

- **LP-0MVC0S6U5003SEDJ** — attribution markers must be parsed first
